$comment: Cat Metro - RevenueCat offering and placement map. v1, 2026-07-31. Offering IDs, package composition and placement->offering wiring are reused verbatim from specs/revenuecat_implementation.md section 2 (steps 8-9). Behavioural rules (trigger/eligibility/caps/cooldown/suppression) come from specs/monetization_spec.md section 3. Every analytics event named here exists in data/analytics_event_taxonomy.csv.
sdk_requirement: Placements require purchases-unity >= 6.9.0; the project pins 9.7.0
client_contract: Game code asks by PLACEMENT id only - IPurchases.GetOfferingForPlacementAsync(placementId). No screen, prefab or presenter may name an offering id. Offering ids appear in exactly two places: the RevenueCat dashboard and the offering_id parameter on analytics events.

global_rules.one_interrupt_per_session: At most ONE system-initiated commerce surface per session. Never two commerce modals back-to-back.
global_rules.failure_embargo: No offer of any kind after a first failure on any level (attempt == 1), and a global 60-second no-offer window after ANY failure unless the player themselves tapped the rewind chip.
global_rules.player_initiated_default: Four of the five placements are player-initiated. Exactly one (post_level_5) is system-initiated, and it fires once per install, ever.
global_rules.no_dark_patterns: No countdowns (we run no timed sales, so none could be honest), nothing preselected, close/back live at >=48dp from frame 1, neutral decline copy ('Keep playing free', 'Maybe later', 'No thanks, retry from start') - confirm-shaming is banned copy.
global_rules.price_rendering: Every price string comes from the store product carried by the offering. No currency literal exists in the binary; a CI regex gate fails the build if a pw_* or shop string contains a currency symbol or digit-dot-digit pattern.
global_rules.payer_suppression: all_access or supporter active -> post_level_5 never fires, bonus_district is unlocked rather than gated, theme rows render Owned, all All Access cross-lines are stripped. Enforced in OfferEligibilityService; QA hard gate asserts zero paywall_viewed for suppressed surfaces.
global_rules.refund_suppression: A refund-revoked account has ALL system-initiated surfaces suppressed for 30 days; player-initiated surfaces stay available and normally styled.
global_rules.offline: Each placement caches its last good offering in the save. Offline, player-initiated surfaces render the cached catalog with a calm offline line; purchase CTAs fail fast (<=2s) with 'No connection right now.' and never spin.
global_rules.supporter_visibility_rule: The supporter package exists inside ofr_core, but SupporterVisibilityRule permits it to RENDER only on the shop screen. post_level_5 and bonus_district bind the all_access package exclusively. This is how the brief-locked 'shop only, never interrupts' constraint survives a shared core offering.

ofr_core.purpose: The complete-edition core. Backs both All Access surfaces and acts as the safe default when any placement fails to resolve.

ofr_themes.purpose: Cosmetic line. Two themes plus a single-line All Access cross-sell.

packages_ordered.render_as: one-line cross-sell, never a third card at launch (PW04 tests promoting it)

ofr_rewind.purpose: Consumable rewind packs for the eligible-failure sheet. Carries no entitlement - fulfillment is the local ConsumableLedger.

packages_ordered.render_as: cross-line under the pack rows only; hidden for payers (All Access doubles the daily free rewind)

ofr_shop.purpose: Full catalog for the always-available shop tab. Removing a package in the dashboard removes the card on next fetch - no app update.

placements.renderer: RevenueCat Paywalls v2 (RevenueCatUI), with the custom UGUI paywall as a crash-strike fallback

packages_filtered_out.reason: brief-locked: Supporter Pack is shop-only and never interrupts (SupporterVisibilityRule)

placements.trigger: level_completed for L5, FIRST completion only, after the results celebration finishes (score counted, stars landed) and before the return to the district map
eligibility: no prior purchase of any SKU (a player who already found the shop is not interrupted)
placements.frequency_cap: Once per install, ever. There is no second attempt, no retry on a later level, no re-arm after reinstall-with-same-save.
placements.cooldown: After dismissal, no system-initiated commerce surface for the remainder of the session (and the one-interrupt-per-session rule continues to apply afterwards).
suppression: refund-revoked accounts (30-day window; this surface also stays once-ever and never re-arms)
anyone who bought a theme or a rewind pack before L5
placements.fallback_when_unresolved: Use the current offering (ofr_core), then the save's cached last-good offering. If both are empty the paywall simply does not present and the moment is consumed silently - the player is never shown an error where an offer was planned.
placements.dismissal: X (top-left, >=48dp, full opacity frame 1), Android back gesture, and a 'Keep playing free' text button - all instant, no exit-intent counter-offer

analytics_events.note: level_id=L5, first completion - the trigger record

success_metric.primary: view -> purchase >= 1.5% by D+14 of live data (self-set; no credible public puzzle paywall benchmark exists - verified 2026-07-31)
success_metric.secondary: median view duration >= 6s (people actually read it)
success_metric.guardrail: D1 retention of viewers not lower than non-viewers; share of dismissals under 2s below 70%

placements.known_risk: This is the single highest-traffic commercial surface and it runs the renderer with three open Android crash issues (#745/#736/#732). The crash-marker strike system disables Paywalls v2 permanently on a device after 2 strikes and the custom paywall takes over with no visible seam.

placements.renderer: Custom UGUI bottom sheet (<=45% of screen height) over the LIVE board, which actually re-skins to the previewed theme while the sheet is open

packages_displayed_ordered.role: action row - shown first when Sakura is the tapped swatch
action row - order swaps to put the tapped theme first
single small cross-line: 'Both themes are included in All Access - {price}'

non_package_rows.detail: 'Try it free for 3 levels' - ad placement theme_rental, 1/theme/day; rendered at equal visual weight with the purchase row; hidden when ads_enabled is off, the daily rental is used, or there is no fill

placements.trigger: Player taps a locked theme swatch (map header, settings, or the results-screen theme chip). Player-initiated ONLY - the system never opens this sheet.
eligibility: the tapped theme is not owned
rental row additionally requires ads_enabled and an unused daily rental for that theme
placements.frequency_cap: None on opening (player-initiated). Rental capped 1/theme/day. Rental-expiry toast capped at 1/day.
placements.cooldown: After a rental expires, a passive 'That was the Sakura Line' toast with a shop link appears at most once per day - never a modal, never mid-level.
suppression: all_access / supporter owners: swatches never render a lock, so the sheet is unreachable; owned single themes show 'Owned - Equip'
the All Access cross-line is stripped for anyone holding all_access
placements.fallback_when_unresolved: NO offering fallback (deliberately not the current offering) - a cosmetic sheet must never escalate into the core paywall. On a null placement the sheet shows the rental row only, or closes cleanly if ads are unavailable.
placements.dismissal: Swipe down, X, back gesture, or 'Maybe later'. The board reverts to the owned theme instantly.

success_metric.secondary: rental -> purchase within 7 days >= 8% (self-set; re-baseline at D+14 of live data)
success_metric.guardrail: rental expiry must generate zero support messages describing it as a takeaway

experiments: PW04 (offering composition: cross-line vs promoted All Access card)
placements.known_risk: Rental expiry can read as a takeaway. Mitigation: silent revert plus one gentle toast, never a modal, never mid-level.

placements.renderer: Custom UGUI full-screen unlock view (district hero art, all 10 level nodes ghosted with their real names visible, All Access benefit list)
placements.trigger: Player taps the Night Harbor district tile on the map. The tile is visible from the first map view and honestly labelled 'All Access' - aspirational, not hidden.
eligibility: non-payer taps the tile - there is no other entry point
placements.frequency_cap: None. It is purely player-initiated and the tile never pulses, badges or animates.
suppression: all_access owners: the tile is simply unlocked and this view is unreachable
refund-revoked accounts still reach it on tap (player-initiated) but with no urgency styling - identical to everyone else
placements.fallback_when_unresolved: Use the current offering (ofr_core), then the cached last-good offering; if both are empty, show the district art with 'Can't reach the store right now - your progress is safe' and no dead CTA.
placements.dismissal: X, back gesture, or 'Back to the map' - all instant

success_metric.primary: view -> purchase >= 6% (highest-intent surface in the game; self-set)
success_metric.secondary: Night Harbor tap rate among D7-retained players >= 40%
success_metric.guardrail: zero reviews describing the map as paywalled - the 30 free levels must read as the game, the 10 locked ones as the bonus

experiments: PW01 (price flows through ofr_core - measured as a secondary read; primary read stays post_level_5)
placements.known_risk: Locked content on the map can read as paywall-in-your-face. Mitigation: static honest tile, no badge, and the free campaign is 30 levels.

packages_displayed_ordered.role: hero card (condensed paywall copy: headline + 3 benefits + CTA)
themes row, with a Preview link into theme_preview
themes row, with a Preview link into theme_preview
rewind row, 'best per rewind' - the only comparative badge in the game, arithmetically true ($0.25 vs $0.40)
bottom card, tip-jar framing with an explicit overlap-honesty line

placements.footer: 'Restore purchases' + 'Manage' (Customer Center) links, and the trust line 'Fair by design: no forced ads, no energy, no loot boxes.'
placements.trigger: Player opens the Shop tab from Home. Also reached from the district-complete passive card and from theme-preview cross-links.
placements.frequency_cap: Shop icon badge: max 1 per genuine content change, clears on open, never pulses.
placements.cooldown: None on the shop itself. The district-complete card that points here is capped at 1 per district completion, 5 lifetime, and is killed forever by one X (shop_card_optout).
suppression: owned items render 'Owned' rather than being hidden - payers can always see what they own
for an all_access owner the Supporter card swaps to the overlap-disclosure copy ('you already own everything in this pack except the Founder extras')
no suppression of the shop itself, ever - restore and Customer Center must always be reachable
placements.fallback_when_unresolved: Use the current offering, then the cached last-good catalog from the save so an offline shop still lists what the player already saw, with 'Can't reach the shop right now - your purchases and progress are safe.'

success_metric.secondary: shop-origin share of revenue >= 30% by D30 (people buying unprompted is the health signal for a fair-by-design catalog)
success_metric.guardrail: restore success rate >= 95% of attempts on accounts with prior purchases; zero restore-related 1-star reviews

placements.known_risk: Neglect - a stale shop reads as abandoned. A weekly copy pass ships alongside the Week-5 mini-event.

placements.renderer: Custom UGUI bottom sheet over the FailureReview screen
row_order_locked: 1. Use today's free rewind (All Access owners see 2 available)
3. Watch an ad for a rewind ({n} left today) - ad placement rewind_failure, caps 2/session and 5/day
6. cm_rewind_20 pack row 'best per rewind' (visually secondary)
7. footer: 'Every level is solvable without rewinds - this just saves the redo.'

packages_displayed_ordered.role: pack row, always below every free option

packages_filtered_out.reason: cross-line only, and hidden entirely for payers; never rendered above the free rows

placements.trigger: level_failed with attempt >= 2 on the same level AND progress_pct >= 40%. That combination renders a rewind chip next to 'Try again'. The SHEET opens only when the player taps the chip - the sheet never auto-presents.
eligibility: attempt >= 2 (attempt 1 is embargoed - the placement is not even fetched)
a safe decision tick exists to rewind to
ad row additionally requires ads_enabled, remaining caps (2/session, 5/day) and fill
placements.frequency_cap: Chip: available whenever eligible. Sheet: opens only on tap. Rewarded rewind: 2/session, 5/day. Cap-explainer line: max 1 render/day.
placements.cooldown: After a pack purchase in this sheet, the pack rows are suppressed for 24h (the player has inventory - do not restock-sell). Global 60s no-offer window after any failure still applies to every OTHER surface.
suppression: payers see the same sheet minus the All Access cross-line
refund-suppressed accounts see free/owned/rewarded rows only for 30 days
accounts with >2 refunded consumable purchases lose the pack rows permanently (free and rewarded rows unaffected)
3 consecutive ad_offer_declined mutes ad rows everywhere for 24h - the decline is a signal, and it is respected
placements.fallback_when_unresolved: NO offering fallback. If the placement returns nothing, the sheet opens with free/owned/rewarded rows and simply omits the pack rows. A failure moment may never be escalated into a core paywall.
placements.dismissal: Swipe down, X, back, or 'No thanks, retry from start'. Retry is never gated on this sheet.

analytics_events.params: level_id, attempt, fail_reason, progress_pct - the eligibility record

success_metric.secondary: rewind-pack attach rate among players with >= 10 failures >= 4%
success_metric.guardrail: ledger reconciliation mismatches = 0 (hard gate); zero paywall_viewed or ad_offer_viewed events with attempt == 1 (asserted in the QA smoke); attempt-1 retry rate >= 80%

placements.known_risk: Any purchase UI near failure can read as monetized difficulty. Mitigations: player-initiated sheet, free options first, a footer promising solvability that solver-validated levels make literally true, and a hard embargo on attempt 1.

surfaces_without_a_placement.why_no_placement: It renders no product and no price - it is a link, not an offer. It resolves a placement only if the player taps through to the shop.
surfaces_without_a_placement.rules: Max 1 per district completion, 5 lifetime, dismissible forever with one X (shop_card_optout), suppressed for payers and refund-suppressed accounts, and never shown in a session that already had a commerce surface.
analytics_events: paywall_viewed (placement=shop) only if the player taps through
surfaces_without_a_placement.success_metric: card -> shop open >= 10%; opt-out rate < 30% (higher means the card annoys)

surfaces_without_a_placement.why_no_placement: Deliberately non-commercial: it is a gift pointer (daily gift + Daily Line), no product, no price, no shop link for payers.
surfaces_without_a_placement.rules: After the next level_completed, never at app open; 6s auto-dismiss; max 1 per 7 days; never in a session with a commerce surface.
surfaces_without_a_placement.success_metric: IAM -> daily_started >= 35%; D7 retention of recipients not below control

surfaces_without_a_placement.why_no_placement: This surface exists in the spec purely to make the ABSENCE of commerce testable.
surfaces_without_a_placement.rules: No rewind chip, no ad offer, no shop badge animation, for everyone including payers.
surfaces_without_a_placement.success_metric: QA assertion: no paywall_viewed and no ad_offer_viewed event can exist with attempt == 1, in any build
